decision.primary_probe_definition: Mean of held-out within-disease library and batch_seq LogisticRegression accuracies when both are scorable; otherwise the scorable subset. library was scorable on 0/150 fold-arm rows (donor-held-out libraries are almost always unseen within disease).
decision.rule: R2 rejected if held-out within-disease nuisance-probe accuracy (mean of library and batch_seq when both scorable; else batch_seq) does not drop ≥ 5 points vs R1, OR donor BA drops > 0.05 vs R1 (plan §4.2 / decision_tree N14).

acceptance.rule: R2 rejected if held-out within-disease nuisance-probe accuracy (mean of library and batch_seq when both scorable; else batch_seq) does not drop ≥ 5 points vs R1, OR donor BA drops > 0.05 vs R1 (plan §4.2 / decision_tree N14).
